## Engineering Mathematics {#vol-07 .section-title}

```{=html}
<section class="wh-hero geo-mountains">
  <div class="wh-hero__body">
    <div class="wh-hero__left">
      <p>This volume covers the core mathematics sequence that first- and second-year engineering students usually experience as separate courses: ordinary differential equations, linear algebra, vector calculus, Fourier methods, PDEs, complex analysis, numerical methods, optimisation, and probability.</p>
      <p>The aim is not to imitate a single textbook chapter order, but to give you the mathematical objects that upper-year engineering courses assume you can already use: state equations, eigenmodes, fields, transforms, discretised systems, and feasible regions.</p>
      <div class="wh-hero__actions">
        <a class="wh-hero__btn wh-hero__btn--primary" href="./odes/01-first-order.html">Start with ODEs</a>
        <a class="wh-hero__btn wh-hero__btn--ghost" href="../">Back to Contents</a>
      </div>
      <div class="book-pill-row">
        <span class="book-pill">6 sections</span>
        <span class="book-pill">First/second year engineering</span>
        <span class="book-pill">Needs Volumes 4–5</span>
      </div>
    </div>
    <aside class="wh-hero__right">
      <div class="wh-hero__panel-label">Details</div>
      <div class="wh-hero__cards">
        <div class="wh-hero-card">
          <div class="wh-hero-card__type">Central move</div>
          <div class="wh-hero-card__title">Building the toolkit</div>
          <div class="wh-hero-card__dek">Each section introduces a class of mathematical object engineers manipulate daily — differential equations, vector spaces, transforms. Broad before specialised.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="wh-hero-card">
          <div class="wh-hero-card__type">Info</div>
          <div class="wh-hero-card__title">Prerequisite</div>
          <div class="wh-hero-card__dek">Volumes 4 and 5 — especially calculus (derivatives and integrals), complex numbers, and linear systems. These are used constantly from the first chapter.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="wh-hero-card">
          <div class="wh-hero-card__type">Info</div>
          <div class="wh-hero-card__title">What comes next</div>
          <div class="wh-hero-card__dek">Volume 8 applies this toolkit inside upper-year disciplines: control, signal processing, continuum mechanics, estimation, and nonlinear optimisation.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </aside>
  </div>
</section>
```

## Section Map {#section-map .section-title}

```{=html}
<div class="wh-book-grid wh-reveal">
  <article class="wh-book-card">
    <span class="wh-book-card__status">Vol 7.1</span>
    <div class="wh-book-card__title"><a href="./odes/01-first-order.html">ODEs and Laplace transforms</a></div>
    <div class="wh-book-card__desc">Model change by relating a system to its own rates. First-order, second-order, systems of ODEs, and the Laplace transform as an algebraic shortcut for solving them.</div>
  </article>
  <article class="wh-book-card">
    <span class="wh-book-card__status">Vol 7.2</span>
    <div class="wh-book-card__title"><a href="./linear-algebra/01-matrices-systems.html">Linear algebra and vector calculus</a></div>
    <div class="wh-book-card__desc">Move from single equations to spaces, fields, and operators. Eigenvalues, vector differential and integral calculus — the language of multivariable physical systems.</div>
  </article>
  <article class="wh-book-card">
    <span class="wh-book-card__status">Vol 7.3</span>
    <div class="wh-book-card__title"><a href="./fourier-pdes/01-fourier-series.html">Fourier analysis and PDEs</a></div>
    <div class="wh-book-card__desc">Decompose signals and solve distributed physical systems. Fourier series, Fourier transforms, and partial differential equations for heat, wave, and diffusion problems.</div>
  </article>
  <article class="wh-book-card">
    <span class="wh-book-card__status">Vol 7.4</span>
    <div class="wh-book-card__title"><a href="./complex-analysis/01-complex-functions.html">Complex analysis</a></div>
    <div class="wh-book-card__desc">Use the complex plane as a practical computational tool. Analytic functions, contour integration, residues, and conformal mapping — with direct application to transforms and filters.</div>
  </article>
  <article class="wh-book-card">
    <span class="wh-book-card__status">Vol 7.5</span>
    <div class="wh-book-card__title"><a href="./numerics/01-numerical-methods.html">Numerical methods</a></div>
    <div class="wh-book-card__desc">Replace exact formulas with controlled approximation. Root finding, interpolation, numerical integration, and numerical methods for ODEs and PDEs — what to use when calculus can't give a closed form.</div>
  </article>
  <article class="wh-book-card">
    <span class="wh-book-card__status">Vol 7.6</span>
    <div class="wh-book-card__title"><a href="./optimisation/01-linear-programming.html">Optimisation and probability</a></div>
    <div class="wh-book-card__desc">Decide and infer under constraints and uncertainty. Linear programming, graph algorithms, mathematical statistics, and probability theory at engineering depth.</div>
  </article>
</div>
```
